inicio.title: DOGS' ARMADA
inicio.description1: The Dogs' Armada has a big problem - respect and order have been disrupted at the canine base! Someone has been leaving poop in the training yard, which as everyone knows is a major breach that stains the dignity of the Guardians of Etheria. According to the code of conduct, all poop must be picked up.
inicio.description2: All this mess needs a solution. Now you must prove your honor by showing that you are not the culprit.

goal.title: Goal
goal.item1: Gather 30 Honor points and prove you are the most respected dog in the Armada. But be careful: while trying to clear your name, the poop piles up... and the more poop, the less honor.

preparation.title: Preparation
preparation.item1: Shuffle all the dog and power cards;
preparation.item3: Give *1* poop card to each player;
preparation.item4: Shuffle all remaining cards (dog, power, and poop) to form the Draw Pile;
preparation.item5: Place the point tokens within everyone's reach;
preparation.item6: Flip the first card from the Pile to start the Training Yard (discard pile).

generalRules.title: General rules
generalRules.item1: The game proceeds in turns, clockwise. Starts with whoever walked their dog most recently.

steps.1: 1. Discard a card from your hand to the Training Yard or draw a card from the Draw Pile.
steps.2: 2. If the discarded card has a power, execute its action.

generalRules.item3: Bonus: if the discarded card has the same value as the previous card in the Training Yard, you can discard a poop card or place it on top of the Draw Pile, as long as the previous card is not another poop.

endRound.title: End of round
endRound.item1: A round ends when a player has 5 poop cards in hand.

steps.2: Shuffle all cards and start a new round;
steps.3: The new round starts with the player who accumulated the most poop cards;
steps.4: In case of a tie, start with the player closest (to the left) of the last player.

item1.title: At the end of each round, players count only the *dog cards* in their hands:

steps.1: The card value equals the number of points earned.
steps.2: Each value can only be counted once per round.
steps.3: Each poop card in hand subtracts 1 point.

item1.title: The game ends when a player reaches *30 or more honor points* at the end of a round.

steps.1: This player is declared the Good Boy of the Armada!
steps.2: Players with fewer points are revealed as bad boys - the true culprits of the dirty yard.
steps.3: In case of a tie, whoever scored the most points in the last round wins.
steps.4: If the tie continues, players share the victory.
